crossRefs.note: These five kings fled, and hid themselves in the cave at Makkedah.
Then Joshua said, “Open the cave entrance, and bring those five kings out of the cave to me.”

people.name: Midian
people.line: A nation descended from Abraham; oppressed Israel in the time of the judges

translations.web: Zebah and Zalmunna fled and he pursued them. He took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and confused all the army.
translations.bsb: When Zebah and Zalmunna fled, Gideon pursued and captured these two kings of Midian, routing their entire army.
translations.kjv: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued after them, and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the host.
translations.asv: And Zebah and Zalmunna fled; and he pursued after them; and he took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the host.
